facts.statement: Harriotta is a genus of cartilaginous fish belonging to the family Rhinochimaeridae.
facts.quote: Harriotta is a genus of cartilaginous fish in the family Rhinochimaeridae.

facts.statement: Species in the genus Harriotta are commonly known as rabbitfish, spookfish, or chimaera.
facts.quote: Some common names for species in the genus include rabbitfish, spookfish and chimaera.

facts.statement: Living Harriotta species inhabit deep waters of continental slopes between 380 and 2,600 meters deep in the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.
facts.quote: Harriotta species can be found in the deep waters of continental slopes around 380 to 2,600 m deep in the Atlantic and the Pacific Oceans.

facts.statement: Harriotta species are found in the Indian Ocean off southern Australia.
facts.quote: It is also known to be found in the Indian Ocean off of southern Australia.

facts.statement: The species Harriotta lehmani was described by Werdelin in 1986 from fossils found in Lebanon dating to the Late Cretaceous (Santonian).
facts.quote: Harriotta lehmani Werdelin, 1986 - Lebanon (Sahel Alma), Late Cretaceous (Santonian)

facts.statement: The species Harriotta gosseleti was described by Winkler in 1880 from fossils found in Belgium dating to the Oligocene (Rupelian).
The species Harriotta avia was described by Finucci, Didier, Ebert, Green, and Kemper in 2024.
facts.quote: Harriotta avia Finucci, Didier, Ebert, Green & Kemper, 2024 (Australasian narrow-nosed spookfish)

facts.statement: Harriotta is classified within the kingdom Animalia, phylum Chordata, class Chondrichthyes, order Chimaeriformes, and family Rhinochimaeridae.
facts.quote: regnum = Animalia | phylum = Chordata | classis = Chondrichthyes | ordo = Chimaeriformes | familia = Rhinochimaeridae | genus = Harriotta

facts.statement: The genus Harriotta includes three species: Harriotta avia, Harriotta haeckeli, and Harriotta raleighana.
facts.quote: El género Harriotta incluye tres especies: Harriotta avia Finucci, Didier, Ebert, Green y Kemper, 2024 Harriotta haeckeli Karrer, 1972 Harriotta raleighana Goode y Bean, 1895

facts.statement: Fossil evidence of the genus Harriotta dates from the Coniacian to Santonian stages, between 89.8 and 83.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Coniacian to Santonian (89.8 to 83.6 million years ago)

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database records two fossil occurrences for the genus Harriotta.
